title: Fix Admin Dashboard mobile layout + enable sidebar scrolling (Motorola G5 / G5 Ace)

requirements.text: Fix the Admin Dashboard layout on small Android phones (specifically Motorola G5 and Motorola G5 Ace) so the admin interface renders without cut-off content, horizontal overflow, or overlapping UI across all admin pages.

quotes: As far as I know we're only having issues with the Motorola 5 and the Motorola 5G Ace the admin panel is not displaying correctly on those phones!

acceptanceCriteria: On Motorola G5 and Motorola G5 Ace sized viewports, visiting /admin and each existing /admin/* route shows a usable layout with no clipped content and no required horizontal scrolling.
Admin pages keep readable spacing and tap targets on narrow screens (e.g., ~360–412px width) while preserving the existing theme styles.
No regressions on tablet and desktop: sidebar + content layout still works at md/lg breakpoints.

requirements.text: Make the main Admin Dashboard content area vertically scrollable on mobile so admins can scroll up/down through page content reliably.

quotes: I should be able to scroll through the dashboard up and down

acceptanceCriteria: On mobile viewports, admin page content (e.g., /admin/products with table, /admin/giveaways, /admin/portfolio) can be scrolled vertically from top to bottom.
No element (e.g., fixed containers) prevents page scrolling; no ‘stuck’ scroll behavior occurs in mobile browsers.

requirements.text: Make the Admin left-side feature/tab navigation independently scrollable so all nav items (including the bottom-most entries like “Verification Codes”) are reachable on short mobile screens without being cut off.

quotes: on the left hand side with all of the different feature tabs I should be able to scroll through those because I can't get to the very bottom ones because they're getting cut off because I can't scroll!

acceptanceCriteria: When the admin navigation list is taller than the available viewport height, the navigation area can be scrolled independently (overflow-y) to reach the last item.
The nav title/header area (e.g., “Admin Panel”) does not prevent scrolling to the bottom nav items on small heights.
Keyboard/touch scrolling works in the sidebar nav on mobile without also forcing horizontal scrolling.

requirements.text: Update the project QA checklist to include explicit verification steps for the Admin Dashboard layout and sidebar scrolling behavior on Motorola G5 and Motorola G5 Ace (or equivalent viewport presets), covering both the main content scrolling and the left navigation scrolling.

quotes: As far as I know we're only having issues with the Motorola 5 and the Motorola 5G Ace the admin panel is not displaying correctly on those phones! Build it!

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/QA-CHECKLIST.md includes a dedicated Admin Dashboard mobile section that mentions Motorola G5 and Motorola G5 Ace (or their viewport sizes) and includes checkboxes for: (1) main admin content vertical scroll, (2) left admin navigation independent scroll, and (3) ability to reach the bottom-most nav item.
Checklist steps are written in clear English and are specific enough to reproduce/verify the fix.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn components are read-only in this environment).
Do not change Internet Identity/auth/admin verification logic; this request is UI layout/scroll behavior only.
nonGoals: Do not add new admin features, pages, or routes.
Do not change admin verification codes, lockout behavior, or backend authorization.
Do not redesign the public site header/navigation as part of this task.
